gloss: two years; for two years; period of two years

definitions.gloss: two years; period of two years
definitions.explanation: A duration of two years. The {間|かん} suffix emphasizes a continuous span of time, distinguishing this from {二年|にねん} which can also mean 'second year.'

examples.japanese: {二年間|にねんかん}{頑張|がんば}った。
examples.english: I worked hard for two years.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{二年間|にねんかん}この{会社|かいしゃ}で{働|はたら}いた。
examples.english: He worked at this company for two years.

examples.japanese: {修士|しゅうし}{課程|かてい}は{二年間|にねんかん}で、{修了|しゅうりょう}には{論文|ろんぶん}の{提出|ていしゅつ}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: A master's program is two years long, and completion requires submitting a thesis.

notes:
Adds the duration suffix {間|かん} to {二年|にねん}, making the meaning unambiguously 'for two years' rather than 'second year.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {二年間|にねんかん}の{経験|けいけん}: two years of experience
- {二年間|にねんかん}{続|つづ}ける: to continue for two years
- {二年間|にねんかん}の{留学|りゅうがく}: a two-year study-abroad period

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {二年|にねん}: two years; second year — shorter form, can be ambiguous between duration and ordinal
- {二年生|にねんせい}: second-year student — ordinal, not duration
